content: Hello, thanks for reaching out! How can I assist you with your account today?
Hi, I’m locked out of my account and need to reset my password urgently.
No problem, I can help with that. Could you please go to the password reset page using the link in your email?
I’ve opened the page. It’s asking for my registered email address.
Great. Please enter your company email address, then click 'Send Code'.
Done. I just received a verification code in my inbox.
Perfect. Enter that verification code on the reset page, and you’ll be prompted to choose a new password.
I entered the code and set a new password. Is there anything else I need to do?
You’re all set! Try logging in with your updated password to confirm access. Let me know if you run into any issues.
